transcript_raw:
Participant: P02 | Session 2 | Cyberpunk 2077 | minimal HUD | Interviewer: Researcher 2
[00:00] Interviewer: Okay [name], thanks. Let's start the interview for session 2.
[00:10] Interviewer: Q1. How did you figure out where to go during the session? What did you look at or rely on?
[00:14] P02: um, like, [silence 3s] I had to ahh, use landmarks like the tall buildings and signs.
[00:43] Interviewer: Q2. Were there moments when something on the screen confused you? What was happening?
[00:48] P02: you know, um, [silence 6s] I was not you know, sure where the objective was.
[01:20] Interviewer: Q3. Which HUD elements, if any, pulled your attention away from what you were doing?
[01:25] P02: um, uhm [silence 7s] I was focused on the world itself, the streets and the people. My friend [name] told me it's the same in other games.
[01:55] Interviewer: Q4. Was there any HUD element that didn't work the way you expected?
[02:00] P02: like, you know, [silence 7s] the prompts uh, were easy to miss without the other stuff.
[02:16] Interviewer: Q5. How aware were you of the passing of time while playing?
[02:23] P02: you know, um, it felt long uhm when I was lost, I kept checking how long it had been.
[02:48] Interviewer: Q6. Was there a point where you had to stop to figure out what the game was telling you?
[02:53] P02: um, you know, [silence 4s] yes, I had to um, stop many times and open the full map.
[03:31] Interviewer: Q7. What information, if any, did you feel was missing from the screen?
[03:39] P02: uh, uhm I wanted the minimap back, and you know, the objective distance.
[04:00] Interviewer: Q8. What would you change about the HUD you just used, and why?
[04:07] P02: uhm you know, I would add a small compass so I do not you know, get lost but keep it clean.
[04:42] Interviewer: Q9. Was there a moment in either session where you felt completely absorbed? What was on screen?
[04:48] P02: uhm uh, [silence 3s] during the fight, you know, I forgot about everything else.
[05:17] Interviewer: Q10. Comparing both sessions, which HUD setup gave you the better experience exploring, and why?
[05:24] P02: um, you know, [silence 5s] the full one because I did not ahh, waste time getting lost.
[05:42] Interviewer: Q11. In which session was it easier to understand what was happening and what to do next?
[05:49] P02: uh, uhm the full HUD was easier to you know, understand what to do next. I usually stream as [username] so I play a lot.
[06:12] Interviewer: Q12. If you could design your own HUD, which elements would you keep and which would you remove?
[06:20] P02: um, like, I would keep health and a compass and remove the notifications. My friend [name] told me it's the same in other games.
